title: hetaeria callosa
intro: Hetaeria callosa, commonly known as the Yellow Pothos or Goldfish Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and attractive foliage. Research on Hetaeria callosa has shown potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including stress relief and immune system support.
